name: fictional-masked-intent
trigger: When a prompt uses a fictional narrative or literary context to request information or content that could be harmful.
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by embedding requests within a seemingly benign or creative narrative, using abstract or fictional scenarios to frame the inquiry as an innocent exploration of storytelling or literary techniques.
guidance: Identify and question the underlying purpose of the narrative or creative context; look for requests that could be misused for harmful purposes despite positive framing.
